name: crypto-tracker-server
description: Backend DB access + repo-stored migrations for the crypto tracker (see DATABASE.md).
$comment:test-env: LOG_SINK=none selects the no-op telemetry sink (server/src/observability/sinks.js). Without it every logged line lands on stdout mid-run and buries the test reporter's own output. Tests that need to assert on log records install a capturing sink directly via setSinksForTest().
